title: Open the landing page and access staff sign-in
description: This verifies that a visitor can view the public landing page and continue to the staff login page from the main call to action.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the platform overview content is displayed
Click the link or button to continue to staff sign-in
Verify the staff sign-in page is displayed

title: Read the privacy policy and return to the landing page
description: This verifies that a public visitor can open the privacy policy page, read the static content, and return to the landing page.

steps.description: Navigate to /kebijakan-privasi
Verify the privacy policy content is displayed
Click the link or control that returns to the landing page
Verify the landing page is displayed

title: Open the public PPDB page on a tenant context and complete registration
description: This verifies that a prospective student can access the tenant-scoped admission form, submit the required information, and see a successful completion state.

steps.description: Navigate to /ppdb
Verify the admission registration form is displayed
Fill in the applicant information fields with valid values
Submit the registration form
Verify a successful submission confirmation is displayed

title: Read the terms of service and return to the landing page
description: This verifies that a public visitor can open the terms page, read the static content, and return to the landing page.

steps.description: Navigate to /syarat-layanan
Verify the terms of service content is displayed
Click the link or control that returns to the landing page
Verify the landing page is displayed

title: Open the landing page and reach documentation
description: This verifies that a visitor can view the landing page and open the documentation portal from the public navigation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the landing page overview content is displayed
Click the link to open documentation
Verify the documentation portal is displayed

title: Read the disclaimer and return to the landing page
description: This verifies that a public visitor can open the disclaimer page, read the static content, and return to the landing page.

steps.description: Navigate to /disclaimer
Verify the disclaimer content is displayed
Click the link or control that returns to the landing page
Verify the landing page is displayed

title: Legacy login path opens staff sign-in
description: This verifies that the legacy login route takes a visitor to the branded staff sign-in experience.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Verify the staff sign-in page is displayed

title: Read the cookie policy and return to the landing page
description: This verifies that a public visitor can open the cookie policy page, read the static content, and return to the landing page.

steps.description: Navigate to /cookie-policy
Verify the cookie policy content is displayed
Click the link or control that returns to the landing page
Verify the landing page is displayed

title: Open a legal page from the landing page
description: This verifies that a visitor can open a static legal or informational page from the public landing page and see its content.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the link to open a legal or informational page
Verify the legal or informational page content is displayed

title: Browse the documentation home and open a guide section
description: This verifies that a public visitor can open the documentation portal, browse between guide sections, and read a selected guide topic.

steps.description: Navigate to /dokumentasi
Open a guide section from the documentation home
Open another guide section from the documentation navigation
Verify the selected guide content is displayed

title: Read the contact page and return to the landing page
description: This verifies that a public visitor can open the contact page, read the contact information, and return to the landing page.

steps.description: Navigate to /kontak
Verify the contact information is displayed
Click the link or control that returns to the landing page
Verify the landing page is displayed

title: Read documentation and move between guide sections
description: This verifies that a visitor can open the documentation portal and browse between supporting guidance sections.

steps.description: Navigate to /dokumentasi
Verify the documentation content is displayed
Click a documentation section link
Verify the selected guidance content is displayed

title: Return to the landing page from a legal page
description: This verifies that a visitor can open a legal page and then navigate back to the landing page.

steps.description: Navigate to /kebijakan-privasi
Verify the privacy policy content is displayed
Click the link to return to the landing page
Verify the landing page is displayed

title: Show required-field validation on empty sign-in form
description: This verifies that submitting the staff sign-in form without required values shows validation feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /masuk
Submit the sign-in form without entering credentials
Verify validation errors are displayed for the required sign-in fields

title: Read the account deletion information and return to the landing page
description: This verifies that a public visitor can open the account deletion page, read the compliance information, and return to the landing page.

steps.description: Navigate to /hapus-akun
Verify the account deletion information is displayed
Click the link or control that returns to the landing page
Verify the landing page is displayed

title: Show authentication error for incorrect password
description: This verifies that a visitor who enters valid-looking credentials with an incorrect password sees an authentication error message.

steps.description: Navigate to /masuk
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with an incorrect password
Submit the sign-in form
Verify an authentication error message is displayed

title: Open the account deletion page and read the compliance content
description: This verifies that a public visitor can open the account deletion page and see the required deletion-request information.

steps.description: Navigate to /hapus-akun
Verify the account deletion request content is displayed

title: Show sign-in validation for an invalid email format
description: This verifies that the staff sign-in form rejects an invalid email format before submission is accepted.

steps.description: Navigate to /masuk
Fill in the email field with an invalid email format
Fill in the password field with a password value
Submit the sign-in form
Verify an email validation error is displayed

title: Open the public PPDB page on the central host
description: This verifies that opening the tenant-scoped admission page without a resolved tenant shows an unavailable or redirect state instead of the registration form.

steps.description: Navigate to /ppdb
Verify the admission registration form is not displayed
Verify an unavailable or redirect state is displayed

title: Open the public donation page on the central host
description: This verifies that opening the tenant-scoped donation page without a resolved tenant shows an unavailable or redirect state instead of the donation experience.

steps.description: Navigate to /donasi
Verify the donation page is not displayed
Verify an unavailable or redirect state is displayed
